title: TheEmptyWorldOfCode
tagline: "In the beginning, there was nothing. Then I pushed to main." Welcome to TheMeptyWorldOfCode,
description:
This project explores the profound beauty of emptiness.
While others build, we abstain. While others ship, we contemplate.
Some call it laziness. We call it... minimalism.

“Perfection is achieved, not when there is nothing more to add,
but when there is nothing left to take away.”
— Antoine de Saint-Exupéry (definitely referring to this repo)
how_its_made:
🛠️ How It’s Made

Ah yes, the technical marvel behind TheMeptyWorldOfCode.

🧱 Tech Stack
Brainpower: 100% overthinking
Keyboard: Lightly tapped, never stressed
Git: For version-controlling the absence of versions
Stack Overflow: Consulted, but only to confirm we needed nothing
🔩 Architecture
Frontend: None
Backend: Also none
Database: Emptiness stored in /dev/null
APIs: You call, nothing answers
CI/CD: Always passes because there's nothing to test
